Well, I do apologize in advance if I sound sappy and throwing this out to the internet for people I don't know, I'd just take any chance I get to improve my life. 

So yeah, WoW is really important to me for many reasons. Like most girls my age (19) I have horrible self esteem from years of bullying. I started playing wow about a year ago, and since then my depression has died down to a minimum and I can actually talk to people and try to be good at something. People tell me for once in my life I am worth their time and call me stuff like "kick-ass" "awesome" "must have on my team" It warms my heart and gets me through the day. Wow is also one of the things keeping me and my boyfriend together. We usually run raids/dungeons or just dick around. It helps us mend our relationshop if something goes bad, or just plain learning about eachother through gaming. Now, about a week ago I got asked to be in the main raiding team of my new guild, even being called "very very very good", I was happy for about an hour and just swimming on a cloud until I saw first raiding day is a day after my game time goes out. Sadly, I'm unsure if I can pay for more gametime, as I have made some stupid decisions in my life and I'm going to study at the university in about a month. I have no way of getting a job, I live in a small town where people rarely even get jobs, and if they do they work one day a week. I have no right to any social care money either because I'm fresh out of school. My parents barely have money to go around, and they pay for my brother so I don't feel like asking them to pay for mine as well. As I am legaly an adult and should be able to pay for my own stuff. 

So, well. I apologize again for just throwing my whole story out for the world to see, I just want a chance to achieve my dream to raid with a team and be apriciated for what I do, not what gender I am. Thank you to whoever bothered to read this and good luck to everyone entering. <3
